title: Gemini Red Team Review — DB 마이그레이션

findings.title: OAuth tokens stored in plaintext
findings.evidence: Account model stores refresh_token, access_token, id_token as plain String?
findings.impact: Database breach exposes linked provider accounts; full account takeover risk.
findings.recommendation: Implement AES-256-GCM encryption via Prisma middleware; store keys in vault.

findings.title: No row-level security or tenant isolation
findings.evidence: All models use userId FK but no RLS, no automatic filter middleware. Queries like findMany() return all rows.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant data leak from any code path missing userId filter.
findings.recommendation: Add Prisma extension middleware to inject userId filter; add PostgreSQL RLS policies.

findings.title: Rollback restores invalid state
findings.evidence: rollbackV1 sets userId='' (invalid) for Customer and Partner records.
findings.impact: Rollback renders data unusable; referential integrity violation.
findings.recommendation: Capture original userId before migration in metadata table; restore during rollback.

findings.title: Hardcoded system user ID in migrations
findings.evidence: userId: 'system-migration-v1' magic string used where FK is required.
findings.impact: FK constraint failures or orphaned data.
findings.recommendation: Create real system user; store UUID in migration metadata.

findings.title: Two conflicting Prisma schemas exist
findings.evidence: Duplicate schema file with space in filename suggests merge conflict artifact.
findings.impact: Accidental usage of old schema undoes v3 fields silently.
findings.recommendation: Delete schema 2.prisma; archive outside prisma/ if needed.

findings.title: No transaction boundaries in migration scripts
findings.evidence: Records updated individually in loops with no transaction wrapper.
findings.impact: Partial migration leaves DB in inconsistent state on failure.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each migration function in prisma.$transaction(); implement chunked transactions.

findings.title: Zero tests for migration/rollback scripts
findings.evidence: No test files exist in packages/db/.
findings.impact: Schema/data changes discovered only in production.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests using test DB; verify counts, rollback, idempotency.

findings.title: No backup/restore procedure
findings.evidence: Destructive operations with no pre-migration backup script.

findings.title: No migration dry-run mode
findings.evidence: Scripts execute writes immediately with no preview or confirmation.

findings.title: Status normalization loses semantic information
findings.evidence: draft, paused, running, archived all map to active.
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish worklow states post-migration.
findings.recommendation: Use semantically correct mapping; add PAUSED and COMPLETED to WorkflowStatus enum.

findings.title: AgentJob has no relation to Task
findings.evidence: AgentJob has taskId String but no @relation to Task.
findings.impact: Orphaned jobs with invalid task references allowed.

findings.title: Migration errors collected but exit code always 0
findings.evidence: Errors logged in array; script exits 0 even with errors.
findings.impact: CI/CD reports success despite data loss.

findings.title: LearningData has no User relation
findings.evidence: LearningData userId String but no User @relation.
findings.impact: Orphaned learning data; GDPR cascade delete missing.

findings.title: Prisma singleton may retain stale connections
findings.evidence: globalForPrisma persists across reloads with no health check or reconnect.
findings.impact: Stale connections after DB restart in development.
findings.recommendation: Add $connect() health check and reconnection middleware.

findings.title: No structured logging in migration scripts
findings.evidence: console.log with emojis; no log levels or file output.
findings.impact: Cannot audit or pipe migration logs to monitoring.

findings.title: Inconsistent table mapping across models
findings.evidence: Some models have @@map to snake_case; others default to PascalCase.
findings.impact: Inconsistent DB naming; confusing for raw SQL.
findings.recommendation: Add @@map to all models for consistent snake_case.

findings.title: MailMessage body stored as plaintext
findings.evidence: body String? has no encryption or size limit.
findings.impact: PII exposure; large emails cause performance issues.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt PII fields; add size constraint.

findings.title: No migration lock mechanism
findings.evidence: No advisory lock or mutex for concurrent safety.
findings.recommendation: Use PostgreSQL advisory lock at migration start.

findings.title: Schema does not support multi-database
findings.impact: Tests require PostgreSQL instance; slower CI.
findings.recommendation: Use env("DATABASE_PROVIDER") or maintain separate test schema.
